verdict.rationale: Fivetran's REST API and its MCP server expose programmatic control over connections (e.g., copying existing connections to new destinations, setting read/write/delete scopes, and a single agent managing multiple connections simultaneously), enabling scripted/bulk-style operations across many connectors rather than manual UI clicks. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-operation endpoint or batch API call spanning many items at once — missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documented examples of operating on many connectors in a single call, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale reliability.
